faqs.q: What are the eligibility criteria for this program?
faqs.a: This program is exclusively for graduates with a background in Accounting or Finance - B.Com, M.Com, BBA (Finance), MBA (Finance), CA/CMA/CS Intermediate candidates, and ICWA aspirants. A strong interest in corporate finance and accounting is essential. Prior work experience is NOT required.

faqs.q: What is the duration of the program?
faqs.a: The program runs for 2 to 3 months. Weekday batches (Mon-Fri) only. All sessions are live instructor-led with recordings available for revision.

faqs.q: What roles can I apply for after completing the training?
faqs.a: After completing this program, you are eligible for roles such as: AP Analyst, AR Analyst, R2R Accountant, General Ledger Accountant, Finance Analyst, Investment Banking Analyst, KYC/AML Analyst, SAP FI Consultant (End User), Accounts Executive, and more - across MNCs, GCCs, and BFSI firms.

We have a 95% placement record and a dedicated placement cell that actively connects students with our 50+ hiring partners. We provide resume building, LinkedIn optimisation, mock interviews, referral letters, and exclusive job drives. While we cannot legally guarantee placements, our track record speaks for itself.

The program includes SAP FI End User training with hands-on practice on a live SAP system covering GL, AP, AR, and asset accounting modules. You will receive an SV Professionals completion certificate for SAP FI. Official SAP certification exams are separate and optional - we guide you through the process.

faqs.q: What is covered under Personality Development and Interview Skills?
faqs.a: This module covers English communication for corporate environments, business email writing, presentation skills, body language and grooming, mock HR and technical interviews, group discussion (GD) practice, salary negotiation skills, and LinkedIn personal branding. We conduct multiple full-length mock interview rounds before placement drives.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Accounting modules and Finance modules?
faqs.a: Accounting modules (AP, AR, R2R, P2P, O2C) focus on day-to-day transactional and reporting functions essential for BPO/GCC/shared services roles. Finance modules (Investment Banking, Financial Markets, M&A, AML/KYC) target analyst and advisory roles in banks, NBFCs, and financial services firms. You get training in BOTH - making you versatile across the industry.

faqs.q: Can I join if I am a working professional?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We offer flexible batch timings designed for working professionals who want to upskill and transition into higher-paying finance roles. All sessions are recorded so you never miss a class.

faqs.q: Is the training online or offline?
faqs.a: We offer both modes. Classroom training is available at our Hyderabad centre with hands-on tool access. Online live sessions are available for outstation students with the same curriculum, assignments, and placement support.
